newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - McDonald's share swap suggested.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - McDonald's share swap suggested.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities analyst Dean Haskell said Wednesday he recommends investors swap out of McDonald's Corp and into Brinker International Inc.
-- EVEREN rates Brinker, which operates several restaurant concepts, outperform. It rates fast-food giant McDonald's market perform in the intermediate term and outperform long term.
-- "We believe that Brinker's relative valuation will improve as we show continued margin improvment and begin earnings improvement over the next four quarters," Haskell wrote in a report.
-- He said he estimates McDonald's will report third quarter earnings of $0.63 a share, $0.01 below consensus. A year ago, it earned $0.56.

-- On October 8, McDonald's named Jack Greenberg to the new position of chairman of McDonald's U.S.A. Greenberg remains vice chairman of the company. Haskell said the management change indicates McDonald's is concerned about the continuing weakness of its U.S. business.
-- "We do not expect the management changes to have significant impact on the competitive nature of the indsutry or McDonald's response to the competition," Haskell said.
